name: Take Root
description:
Concentration, up to 1 hour.

Your plant ward spreads along your limbs, extending roots from your hands and feet that cling to surfaces, objects, and creatures.

On your turn, you may spend a Half Action to attach or release these roots. To attach to a creature, roll Spirit vs. Dexterity; on a win, the roots take hold. On a loss, no effect.

While attached, you remain firmly adhered. You may spend an Action to crush or constrict the target, dealing 1d8 + HEART damage to the object or creature you are attached to.

If a creature attempts to pull you free, roll Spirit vs. Strength. On a win, you remain attached. On a loss, you are dislodged.
